# The initial MailUtils tab warning requested IDs that its Fluent patch did not add

The original tab caller uses singular open-tab-warning-confirmation IDs, while the added resource and recipe use open-tabs-warning-confirmation. Accepted source later uses the matching plural IDs. The standalone-window IDs already match in the original. Preserve the original mismatch and later repair rather than claiming a clean text-only migration or a reproduced missing-message failure.

Scope: Message-opening warning localization IDs.
